title: Unbalancedness in Neural Monge Maps Improves Unpaired Domain Translation
tldr_zh: 证明 unbalanced Monge map 等价于重缩放测度间的 balanced map，可插入任意估计器；UOT-FM 在图像翻译上优于 OT-FM
tldr_en: Unbalanced Monge map equals balanced map between rescaled measures; UOT-FM improves unpaired image translation over OT-FM
